component.name: QR Code & Barcode Scanner
component.summary: Read QR codes and barcodes from image files

description.p: qrscan reads the QR codes, barcodes and other 2D codes of an image file and prints what it found as JSON: the format of each code, its exact content and where it sits in the image.
For a QR code it also gives a scannability score, with the reasons behind it. That helps before printing an artistic or AI-generated QR code.
It runs on this computer. No image and no result is sent over the network, and a decoded link is never opened.
